original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚FCT部长称NLC与NUT无限期罢工系政治动机的敲诈
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区（FCT）部长尼耶索姆·维克在阿布贾媒体交流会上称，尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）与尼日利亚教师联盟（NUT）发起的无限期罢工是出于政治动机的敲诈，意在使政府瘫痪。维克指控NLC主席具有党派动机，并否认FCT政府拖欠教师款项，同时威胁对工会领导人采取法律行动。NLC FCT理事会于10月7日因与NUT及FCTA之间未解决的问题宣布无限期罢工。

key_facts.fact: FCT部长维克称NLC与NUT的无限期罢工是出于政治动机的敲诈
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Mr Nyesom Wike, has described the strike declared by the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) and the Nigeria Union of Teachers (NUT) as a politically motivated blackmail aimed at paralysing the government.

key_facts.fact: 维克在阿布贾媒体交流会上指控NLC主席具有党派动机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Speaking during a media chat in Abuja on Tuesday, Wike claimed that the ongoing labour dispute... was being driven by opposition political interests rather than genuine worker grievances.

key_facts.fact: 维克否认FCT政府拖欠教师款项并称已履行财政义务
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Addressing accusations that the FCT Administration owes teachers unpaid entitlements and promotion arrears, Wike insisted that his administration has met its financial obligations

key_facts.fact: 维克威胁对工会领导人采取法律行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He threatened to take legal action against the labour union leaders to curb their actions, adding that FCTA’s legal advisers were currently finalising the suit.

key_facts.fact: NLC FCT理事会于10月7日宣布无限期罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the NLC, FCT Council had on Oct. 7 declared an indefinite strike over unresolved issues between the FCTA and the NUT.

uncertainties: 维克关于罢工出于政治动机的指控尚未得到独立证实
维克关于FCT政府不拖欠教师款项的说法与工会指控存在冲突
目前仅有一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
